title: Complete Graham's GCD Conjecture (Work in Progress)

problemStatement.plain: AVAILABLE: This proof is marked as work in progress and needs completion.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Added 4 new theorems. Proved: dvd_lt_imp_le_half (proper divisor bound), erdos_402_pair (two-element case), max_ge_card_of_pos (pigeonhole for positive Finsets), erdos_402_contains_one (1-in-A case). 1 sorry remains (main conjecture, needs deep sieve theory).
builtItems: counterexample_124_not_case: {1,2,4} is not a Graham equality case
dvd_lt_imp_le_half: proper divisors are at most half
erdos_402_pair: main conjecture for |A|=2 via proper-divisor bound
max_ge_card_of_pos: max(A) ≥ |A| for positive Finset A
erdos_402_contains_one: main conjecture when 1 ∈ A via pigeonhole
insights: Equality characterization is false: {1,2,4} is a counterexample (primitive, satisfies GCD condition, not in three families)
For two-element sets: gcd of distinct elements is a proper divisor of the larger, so ≤ max/2 = max/|A|
Key to disproving case 2: L/1 = L must be in image, so L ∈ {1,2,4}, but lcm(1,...,n) cannot equal any of these for n≥3
Coprimality of 2 and 3 forces 6|L when n≥3, ruling out L≤4
Pair case reduces to: gcd properly divides max element, so gcd ≤ max/2 = max/card
Contains-one case: gcd(max,1)=1 and max≥card by pigeonhole (A ⊆ {1,...,max})
max_ge_card_of_pos proved via injection into range(max+1)\{0} using card_sdiff
nextSteps: Main conjecture (erdos_402_graham_conjecture) requires Balasubramanian-Soundararajan sieve argument
Could try proving for |A|=3 but case analysis becomes complex
Consider reduction: if A has common factor d, divide by d to reduce to primitive case
Coprime pair existence: if A has two coprime elements with max≥card, bound follows
